Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class ListingStore

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.ListingStore
public class ListingStore extends Object
Listings, kept in memory and written to the listings and listing_photos tables on every change and loaded back at startup (load(UserStore)). They survive a restart once the reset-on-start switch is turned off (#59).

Change a listing's fields, then call update(Listing); never change a Listing and skip the store.

    • find

      public Listing find(String id)
      Resolves a listing by id, including deleted ones: chat threads, deals and notification links keep working after a listing is hidden. Callers that want visible listings only must use one of the filtered collections (all(), live(), pending(), bySeller(String) or findAll(List)).

    • reserveId

      public String reserveId()
      Claims and returns the next L... id in one atomic step. The submit flow reserves an id before saving so photos can be keyed to the directory the listing will actually get; two concurrent callers can never receive the same id. add(Listing) leaves a pre-set id untouched and does not advance the counter again.

    • findAll

      public List<Listing> findAll(List<String> ids)
      The listings with these ids, in the same order, skipping missing and deleted ids.

    • recordView

      public void recordView(Listing listing)
      Counts one view of a listing's details (SRS UC-1.3 S1 step 2) and saves it. Synchronized so two buyers opening the listing at once both count.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the listing is not in this store, or its row is gone from the database (e.g. deleted a moment ago); nothing changes then

    • add

      public void add(Listing listing)
      Adds a new listing (giving it the next L... id if it has none) and saves it.

    • update

      public void update(Listing listing)
      Saves every field of an existing listing (status, reasons, dates, view count, details and photos). Also accepts a new object for the same id, which then replaces the old one.

    • remove

      public void remove(String id)
      Deletes a listing and its photos, e.g. a seller withdrawing a listing nobody has acted on. A listing with requests or deals (and, from #57/#58, chats or reports) cannot be deleted: the database refuses, this throws DatabaseException and nothing changes. Take such a listing down by status instead (#26, #34).
